name: crypto-alts/alt-sleeve-blend
title: Alt sleeve blend — BAB + token dilution + volume attention + funding crowding
description: Four uncorrelated long/short sleeves on a point-in-time top-20 liquid-alt universe, summed at the weight level with constant IS-fixed risk weights (BAB 0.2226, 12-week circulating-supply dilution 0.2921, abnormal-volume attention 0.2461, contrarian Binance perp-funding crowding 0.2392) at leverage 2.0; trades in the same coin net across sleeves. Market-neutral on average (beta to BTC -0.02), BTC hedge legs, daily targets at the 00:00 UTC close.
direction: long/short (market-neutral on average; net dollar exposure +0.11 average)

backtest.cost_type: 10 bp per side on the netted sum|dw|; short-leg carry NOT modelled

benchmark.name: live BAB book (crypto-alts/xs-momentum-neutral) alone, same window, matched vol

live_notes: SIM book: filled at the yfinance daily close from the shared data/ cache -- no order book, no rejection, no partial fill. Weaker evidence than a venue fill; do not read this track as exchange-cleared. Binance spot cannot hold the short legs, so the venue book was never an option.

Cost: fee 10 bp + slippage 0 bp = the research's 10 bp/side on netted turnover. Report ladder: 0/5/10/20/30 bp -> OOS 1.37/1.34/1.31/1.24/1.18. broker_from_meta (dashboard flatten) rebuilds with library default slippage; affects a one-off flatten only.

UNMODELLED short-leg carry (funding/borrow) on ~0.48 average short notional at L=2: 5/10/20 %/yr -> OOS 1.20/1.09/0.88. The sim ledger charges none, so the live curve flatters a real one by that amount.
Leverage: max_gross 2.0 = the spec's validated cap at LEVERAGE 2.0 (backtest average gross 1.08, max 2.003 on one day, which the broker would scale by 0.998).

Coexists with the older single-sleeve crypto-alts/xs-momentum-neutral book (BAB is 22% of this blend's risk). The report calls this an upgrade of that book; retiring the old one is an operator decision, not taken at deploy.

Data feeds refreshed by the runner on every run: yfinance daily bars (64 legs); Binance USD-M funding for the 64 PERP_OF perps (fapi.binance.com, re-fetched from 3 days before each file's last stamp -- nothing else refreshes these); CoinMarketCap weekly snapshots via cmc.fetch_weekly (keyless, UNOFFICIAL data-api endpoint; incremental). If CMC goes stale > 10 days the dilution sleeve drops names and goes flat by its own rule -- the runner logs a warning. If no name has funding on the decision bar the step raises and is retried next day.

Universe frozen to the 64 columns of weights_final.parquet (62 alt candidates Yahoo serves + BTC-USD + ETH-USD == funding_panel.PERP_OF). The runner's frozen loader returns inputs identical to strategy.load_inputs() (verified at deploy). The ledger keys off this list -- editing it restarts the book.

Stalled-book failure mode: SimPortfolioBroker.bar_key is the minimum bar across all 64 legs, so if Yahoo stops serving any one (OMG, XEM, ONE are near-dead) the book stops advancing ('bar already traded' daily). Drop the stale ticker from TRADED if that happens.

Timing: every input truncated to rows dated before the current UTC day (yfinance's last row is always forming); weight from the last complete bar, applied next day (backtest_xs convention). Funding keeps its 8h safety lag, CMC snapshots their +1 day known-lag. Daemon wakes 00:30 UTC.

Deploy check 2026-09-27 23:50 UTC: runner --check weights on decision bar 2026-09-26 equal strategy.blend_weights(strategy.load_inputs()) recomputed on the same data to max|diff| = 0.0; gross 1.036, net +0.215, 21 legs. weights_final.parquet stores the UNSHIFTED decision-at-close-t weight (lag 0, max|diff| 0.0 over every row through 2026-09-20; later rows differ only because the funding files were stale at research time and were refreshed by the runner).

Caveats from the report: sleeve set is semi-out-of-sample (members' OOS known when the inclusion rule was written); walk-forward inclusion control gives 0.71 on 2021-26; 2026 YTD is -0.79 with every sleeve negative.
